[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - Loading Isotherm Determination

Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End Date / Report Generated: [[REPORT_DATE]]

Objective

Determination of loading isotherms for ligand [[LIGAND_NAME]] on the selected resin using a fully automated workflow at different salt concentrations ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]), with ligand concentrations [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]].

The goal is to quantify bound ligand per gram of resin at equilibrium and derive characteristic loading isotherms at incubation temperature [[INCUBATION_TEMPERATURE]] and measurement wavelength [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm.

Methods

Reagents and General Parameters
  • Resin mass per well: [[RESIN_MASS]]
  • Ligand: [[LIGAND_NAME]]
  • Ligand stock concentration: [[LIGAND_STOCK_CONCENTRATION]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Ligand concentrations tested: [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]] (total: [[NUMBER_OF_LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]])
  • Salt: [[SALT_NAME]]
  • Salt stock concentration: [[SALT_STOCK_CONCENTRATION]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Salt concentrations tested: [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]] (total: [[NUMBER_OF_SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]])
  • Buffer: [[BUFFER]]
  • Total working volume per well: [[TOTAL_VOLUME]]
  • Replicates per condition: [[REPLICATES]]
  • Incubation temperature: [[INCUBATION_TEMPERATURE]]
  • Incubation shaker speed: [[SHAKER_SPEED_INCUBATION]]
  • Measurement wavelength: [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm
  • Calibration curve slope: [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]]
  • Calibration curve intercept: [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]]
Automated Workflow Overview

The loading isotherm experiment was executed using an integrated robotic platform combining an Opentrons OT-2 pipetting robot, a UR5 robotic arm, a vacuum manifold with vacuum pump, and a Tecan Spark platereader. The workflow comprised automated equilibration of the resin, loading of ligand solutions at different salt concentrations, incubation, filtration, and spectrophotometric measurement of unbound ligand.

1. Resin Preparation and Initial Equilibration
  • The UR5 robot transferred a 96-deep-well plate ("96DeepWP") containing the resin slurry from storage to the vacuum manifold position (Pump_Pos1) and placed the vacuum manifold.
  • A 96-well filter plate ("Filterplate") pre-loaded onto the Opentrons OT-2 (OT2_Pos1) was transferred by the UR5 to the vacuum manifold position (Pump_Pos2).
  • The VacuuPump applied a vacuum at speed [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] s to drain liquid through the filter plate.
  • After vacuum application, the system vented for [[VENTING_TIME]] s to release pressure before the UR5 returned the filter plate to the OT-2 deck (OT2_Pos1).
2. Automated Equilibration Cycles
  • The equilibration sequence was repeated for [[EQUILIBRATION_CYCLES]] automated cycles to ensure the resin was equilibrated with buffer [[BUFFER]] and the appropriate salt concentration.
  • In each equilibration cycle (duration [[EQUILIBRATION_CYCLE_DURATION]]):
    • The Opentrons OT-2 ran a protocol using the custom labware definition cytiva_96_filterwellplate_1ml.json to add [[EQUILIBRATION_VOLUME]] of equilibration buffer (containing [[SALT_NAME]] at the target concentration) to each well of the filter plate.
    • The UR5 robot transferred the filter plate from the OT-2 (OT2_Pos1) to the vacuum manifold position (Pump_Pos2).
    • The VacuuPump applied vacuum at speed [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] s, followed by venting for [[VENTING_TIME]] s.
    • The UR5 returned the filter plate to the OT-2 deck (OT2_Pos1) to complete the cycle.
  • After completion of all equilibration cycles, the UR5 removed the vacuum manifold and returned the deep-well plate to storage.
3. Ligand Loading and Incubation
  • The Opentrons OT-2 executed a protocol to dispense ligand solutions at different concentrations [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]], prepared from [[LIGAND_STOCK_CONCENTRATION]] stock, into the equilibrated resin-containing wells.
  • Salt concentrations [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]] were combinatorially distributed across the plate so that each ligand concentration–salt concentration combination was represented with [[REPLICATES]] replicates.
  • Total volume per well after loading was [[TOTAL_VOLUME]].
  • The utility pause prompted the user to cover the filter plate with foil and prepare fresh tips and empty trash, ensuring consistent incubation conditions.
  • The OT-2 then ran an incubation protocol for [[INCUBATION_TIME]] at shaker speed [[SHAKER_SPEED_INCUBATION]] to allow ligand–resin binding to reach equilibrium.
  • A second pause step requested removal of foil prior to filtration.
4. Post-Incubation Filtration
  • The UR5 transferred a fresh 96-deep-well plate ("96DeepWP") to the vacuum manifold position and placed the vacuum manifold.
  • The incubated filter plate was moved from the OT-2 (OT2_Pos1) to the vacuum manifold (Pump_Pos2).
  • The VacuuPump applied vacuum at speed [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] s to separate resin-bound ligand from supernatant.
  • After a venting period of [[VENTING_TIME]] s, the UR5 moved the filter plate to storage, removed the vacuum manifold, and placed the deep-well plate containing filtrates on the OT-2 deck (OT2_Pos5).
5. Preparation of Measurement Plate and Spectrophotometric Readout
  • The UR5 placed an empty 96-well plate ("WP1") on the OT-2 deck (OT2_Pos1).
  • The OT-2 ran a protocol to transfer defined volumes of filtrate from the deep-well plate (OT2_Pos5) into the measurement plate (WP1), according to the experimental design.
  • The UR5 then moved the deep-well plate back to storage and transferred the measurement plate WP1 to the Tecan Spark reader.
  • The Tecan Spark was closed and the measurement method was executed at wavelength [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm.
  • After measurement, the UR5 returned the measurement plate to storage.
6. Data Processing
  • Absorbance values at [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm were converted to unbound ligand concentrations using the calibration curve (slope [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]], intercept [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]]).
  • Loaded ligand per gram of resin was calculated from the difference between initial ligand concentration and measured unbound concentration, normalized by [[RESIN_MASS]].
  • Loading isotherms were constructed for each salt concentration [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]].

Results

Loading Isotherms for [[LIGAND_NAME]] at Different [[SALT_NAME]] Concentrations
[[PLOT_1]]

Figure 1: Loading isotherms showing equilibrium loading of [[LIGAND_NAME]] (amount bound per gram of resin) as a function of initial ligand concentration [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]] for different [[SALT_NAME]] concentrations ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]). Data were obtained using an automated workflow with [[REPLICATES]] replicates per condition at incubation temperature [[INCUBATION_TEMPERATURE]] and measured at [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm.

Interpretation of the isotherms, including comparison of maximum loading capacity and apparent affinity across salt conditions, should be added here based on the observed trends in Figure 1.
